info.name: Girder REST API (Emory Digital Slide Archive) annotation dicomweb_assetstore API
Import references to DICOM objects from a DICOMweb server

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the assetstore representing the DICOMweb server.

params.name: destinationId
params.description: The ID of the parent folder, collection, or user in the Girder data hierarchy under which to import the files.

params.name: destinationType
params.description: The type of the parent object to import into.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of studies to import.

params.name: filters
params.description: Any search parameters to filter the studies query.

params.name: progress
params.description: Whether to record progress on this operation.

items.docs: Import references to DICOM objects from a DICOMweb server
